{
 "query": "racing gaming equipment selection garage",
 "filters": {
  "industry": "gaming"
 },
 "count": 3,
 "tip": "Top rows carry the fold autopsy; get_screen(slug) for the others. Hero complete inside 1280x800; 80-160px between sections; copy in a centered padded column.",
 "images": "https://0nme3pk5am3urwa9.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/captures/<slug>/hero.1440.webp (also full.1440, thumb.384, mobile.384; get_screen returns exact URLs)",
 "results": [
  {
   "slug": "itch-io",
   "title": "Itch",
   "northstar": "Deep charcoal clarity - geometric sans-serifs on a stark, binary canvas.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top nav bar spans full width, logo left, links center (Browse Games, Game Jams, Upload Game, Developer Logs, Community), search + Log in/Register right. Below: two-column layout, left sidebar (POPULAR TAGS, BROWSE, GAMES BY PRICE, social icons, blog feed), right main area. Hero is a featured game card (\"The Knife Sharpener\") with video thumbnail left (play button overlay, ~55% width), title + tagline + \"Get the game →\" button right. Below hero: \"Latest Featured Games\" grid (5 cards). Headline \"The Knife Sharpener\" is title case, left-aligned, 2 lines, small scale. CTA is rounded rectangle with arrow. Visual dominates left; text sits right. Balance: 60/40 visual/text split inside ~1280x800.\n\nTYPE: Sans display (bold, condensed, tight tracking for game titles) + sans body (regular, open); moderate scale jump. Uppercase for section headers (\"POPULAR TAGS\"). Small caps feel in nav.\n\nCOLOR: Background #d2c69d (warm beige page), cards #fff; text #3b2c18 (dark brown); accent #df381e (red-orange) on \"Add your game,\" \"View all →\" outline, sale badge. No accent on primary CTA (dark button).\n\nSIGNATURE: Asymmetrical featured-game card with embedded video thumbnail + play button, flanked by smaller screenshot strip, breaking the grid's rectangle rhythm.",
   "palette": ["#df381e", "#3b2c18", "#eeb334", "#947d7a", "#d2c69d"],
   "fonts": ["Lato"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "feature-stack",
   "axes": "mid / grotesk-sans / warm / Lato",
   "tags": "minimalism, brutalism · gaming, ecommerce · serious, technical, cold · hero-with-cta, feature-trio, logo-cloud, sticky-nav"
  },
  {
   "slug": "discord-com",
   "title": "Discord",
   "northstar": "Electric indigo depth, friendly rounded forms, playful sans-serifs float in a digital nebula.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Nav pinned top, logo left, links center, white pill \"Log In\" right. Headline \"GROUP CHAT THAT'S ALL FUN & GAMES\" bold italic sans, 3 lines, left-aligned, fills ~40% width. Supporting copy 3 lines beneath. Two CTAs: white rounded-rect \"Download for Mac\" with down-arrow icon, purple rounded-rect \"Open Discord in your browser\". Hero visual: 3D-rendered Discord interface on monitor plus phone, flanked by stylized characters and game controller, occupies right ~55%, bleeds to edge. Headline left, visual right, balanced asymmetrically.\n\nTYPE: Display: extra-heavy compressed sans, italic, faux-wide (Ginto Nord or similar). Body: clean sans, ~14px. Massive jump: display ~72px vs body. All-caps headline with ampersand.\n\nCOLOR: Deep indigo gradient background (#0c0484 to #2b33ac). White text. Accent #5a5ae5 on secondary CTA; pale lavender (#b8a2c8) ghost shapes in background.\n\nSIGNATURE: Italic all-caps headline with ampersand, set against 3D device mockups with floating cartoon characters spilling past image boundaries.",
   "palette": ["#2b33ac", "#0c0484", "#5a5ae5", "#6b6c92", "#b8a2c8"],
   "fonts": ["Abcgintodiscordnord", "Ggsans", "ABC Ginto Normal"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "feature-stack",
   "axes": "mid / grotesk-sans / cool / Abcgintodiscordnord",
   "tags": "playful, dark-mode · media, gaming · playful, technical, warm · hero-fullbleed, hero-with-cta, logo-cloud, feature-trio, sticky-nav"
  },
  {
   "slug": "epicgames-com",
   "title": "Epicgames",
   "northstar": "Icy glass forms hover in a vibrant amethyst and coral nebula, bold futuristic sans-serif.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top nav: logo left, \"STORE\" bold, Support/Distribute center-left, globe/Sign in/Download pill right. Sub-nav: search bar left, Discover/Browse/News right. Centered hero: \"MEGA SALE\" massive stacked two lines, all-caps. Below: \"The Epic Games MEGA Sale 2026\" + body copy. White rounded pill CTA \"Save Now\". Deadline pill below. 3D chrome skull upper-left, crystalline shapes scattered, iridescent ribbon lower-right. Visuals occupy ~60% frame, headline dead center. Balanced: heavy graphics flank light center text.\n\nTYPE: Display: ultra-condensed sans, extra bold, tight tracking, slight vertical stretch. Body: clean sans, medium weight. Massive jump - display ~8x body. All-caps signature on display only.\n\nCOLOR: Gradient background teal-to-pink (#1eb3e6 through #ee9388 to #6f1584). White text. Accent #1eb3e6 on Download button; no accent in hero text.\n\nSIGNATURE: Iridescent chromatic 3D objects - skull, crystals, ribbon - floating at frame edges, leaving center open for text. Reproduce: reflective holographic material, scattered depth, asymmetric framing.",
   "palette": ["#1eb3e6", "#6f1584", "#ee9388", "#8267a8", "#c172a3"],
   "fonts": ["Inter"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "marquee-hero",
   "axes": "mid / grotesk-sans / chromatic-other (~319) / Inter",
   "tags": "playful, futurist, glassmorphism, dark-mode · gaming · luxe, cold, playful · hero-fullbleed, hero-with-cta, logo-cloud"
  }
 ]
}
